diff --git a/openlibrary/tests/solr/test_query_utils.py b/openlibrary/tests/solr/test_query_utils.py
index e639944..243d392 100644
--- a/openlibrary/tests/solr/test_query_utils.py
+++ b/openlibrary/tests/solr/test_query_utils.py
@@ -1,8 +1,11 @@
 import pytest
+from luqum.parser import parser
+from luqum.tree import Word
 from openlibrary.solr.query_utils import (
     EmptyTreeError,
     luqum_parser,
     luqum_remove_child,
+    luqum_replace_child,
     luqum_traverse,
 )
 
@@ -32,6 +35,39 @@ def test_luqum_remove_child(query: str, to_rem: str, expected: str):
     assert fn(query, to_rem) == expected
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('query', ['foo AND foo AND bar', '(foo)', 'NOT foo'])
+def test_luqum_replace_child(query: str):
+    parent = parser.parse(query)
+    original_children = parent.children
+    old_child = original_children[0]
+    new_child = Word('baz')
+
+    assert luqum_replace_child(parent, old_child, new_child) is None
+    assert type(parent.children) is type(original_children)
+    assert len(parent.children) == len(original_children)
+    assert all(
+        actual is (new_child if child == old_child else child)
+        for actual, child in zip(parent.children, original_children)
+    )
+
+
+def test_luqum_replace_child_missing_child():
+    parent = parser.parse('foo AND bar')
+    original_children = parent.children
+
+    luqum_replace_child(parent, Word('missing'), Word('baz'))
+
+    assert parent.children == original_children
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('query', ['foo', 'title:foo'])
+def test_luqum_replace_child_unsupported_parent(query: str):
+    parent = parser.parse(query)
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='^Not supported for generic class Item$'):
+        luqum_replace_child(parent, Word('foo'), Word('bar'))
+
+
 def test_luqum_parser():
     def fn(query: str) -> str:
         return str(luqum_parser(query))
